headline: Un1t is already banked this morning despite a red readiness call — protect the rest of today and keep tomorrow's easy run genuinely easy.
body_state: Deterministic verdict is red: readiness 40.9/100, driver sleep. 26h of 14-day sleep debt after just 5.4h last night (sleep score 54), deep sleep only 11% (target 13-23%) with zero REM. Body battery recharged just +31 overnight and sits at 33 now — under the 40 threshold quality work needs. Resting HR is up to 53 vs your 49.6 baseline. Training status reads "Recovery" and the overtraining composite is "caution." TSB -17 is technically the productive zone, but stacked on this sleep/battery picture it's not a green light for more load today.
session: Today's Un1t class is already done (07:07, 41.2 of 45 min booked) — and it landed hard: avg HR 133/max 168, 62% of the class in zone 3-4, TE aerobic 2.7 / anaerobic 2.6. That's real load stacked on exactly the morning the readiness call was for an easy swap, not more intensity. Nothing else is booked today — treat the rest of it as recovery, no extra cardio. Tomorrow's plan session is a 7km easy run (4:50-5:19/km): hold it there. Three of the last four "easy/moderate" sessions ran hot — don't make it four.
recent: The pattern repeating all week: Aug 10's "easy" run spent most of its time in zone 3, not easy. Aug 11 stacked a zone-3-heavy Un1t with a 2h road ride the same evening. Aug 12's tempo underdelivered — only 2.98 of 4km at threshold, HR topping out at 156 (never reaching your 163 threshold) despite an RPE 8. Today's Un1t continues it: booked as cardio, ran 62% zone 3-4. Four sessions in a row where the label (easy/moderate) didn't match the physiology (hard) — that's the grey-zone limiter, not bad luck.
focus: Rest of today: no more load — let body battery and sleep debt recover.
Tomorrow's easy run: cap HR ~135, hold 4:50-5:19/km — break the pattern of "easy" sessions running hot.
Bed ~60 min earlier tonight — deep sleep is 11% and debt is 26h over 14 days.
